description: This file defines a generic internal class 'DurableState<T>' implementing persistent state management with serialization, versioning, and command application logic within the Orleans framework. It handles storing, updating, and applying log entries to durable state instances.

classes.name: DurableState<T>
classes.description: A generic class implementing persistent state with serialization, version control, and command application, used as part of Orleans' durable state mechanisms.

methods.name: DurableState
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the durable state, registers it with a manager, and injects dependencies.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Increments version and triggers persistence callback after a write operation.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the current state value to default.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies log entries to update the state, handling versioning and command types.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends log entries to the state machine log.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Appends a snapshot to the state machine log.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the durable state (not implemented).

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes and writes the current state to a storage writer.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state asynchronously via the manager.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes the state via the manager.
